known_observations.description: YOLO reports a short lower-body fragment behind the foreground person. Its guessed head can cover a small part of a leg although no face is visible there.
known_observations.safety_tradeoff: Only fully covered guessed heads are suppressed; current detected faces always remain protected. Do not relax that rule merely to erase an ambiguous fragment overlay.
known_observations.acceptance: This is an explicit precision limitation, not a zero-false-positive claim. The known final-frame580 foreground trouser-leg probe remains clear.

known_observations.description: During face-detector misses, recent supported face padding is added to the current head fallback. This closes the visible partial-face leak, but can also cover an arm/background and show two stickers.
known_observations.safety_tradeoff: History is not used to remove current-frame fallback coverage or grant identity exemptions. The padding expires after800ms and cannot renew itself.
known_observations.acceptance: Explicit precision limitation; tests do not claim one perfect face rectangle or zero overmask for every frame.

known_observations.description: Selected root0 remains on the left mirror. The existing FULL_BODY class guard can additionally mask newly observed/uncertain bodies. Foreground extra protection at frame39 is8040 pixels in both the earlier regression and the final run.
known_observations.safety_tradeoff: The inherited unknown-class fail-closed guard is preserved; this is not a claim that only one body is masked on every frame.
